_claudeMdNote: CLAUDE.md is gitignored, so the release checklist's consistency grep could never see version drift inside it — this file's 'Live facts' line claimed APP_VERSION 0.34.0 and 1159 tests across 74 files against an actual 0.34.2 / 1163 / 75. Only APP_VERSION is machine-checked; the test and file counts on the same line cannot be checked against package.json and must be updated by hand. Skipped in CI, where the file is never checked out. A second declaration, the `## Current State (vX.Y.Z)` heading, was found stale immediately after v0.34.4 shipped — the original pattern only matched the 'Live facts' line. Both are checked now; if another version declaration is added to CLAUDE.md, add its pattern here too.

commands.name: typecheck
commands._note: Deliberately separate from `build`. `next build` typechecks the production build graph but NOT test files, so 33 type errors sat undetected in five __tests__ files — all of them Vitest 3→4 `vi.fn<Args, Return>` generics that silently typed the mocks as `never`, meaning those tests were not type-checking their own mock usage at all. Fixed in v0.34.4; this step is what keeps them fixed. cfd and GanttApp were verified clean including tests, so they do not carry this step.
